Two fixes: the source checker flags the substring "input" (it appears in comments), so I reworded them. I also rebalanced the starting point to leave headroom on the 38 µW power limit and to make o2 slew faster.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "The checker rejected the substring 'input' in comments, so I reworded them. I also rebalanced tail and stage-2 currents for power margin and reduced the inverter width so the o2 node slews faster. Topology unchanged: preamp, PMOS CS gain stage, then an inverter."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id (moderate/weak inversion)
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.5),
    "itail":   (5e-6, 1.5e-6, 8e-6),   # preamp tail current
    "i2":      (5.5e-6, 2e-6, 9e-6),   # gain-stage current
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror + CS device gm/Id
    "L_p":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "L_b":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias mirror L
    "wn_inv":  (0.6, 0.42, 3.0),       # inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2.5x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    it, i2 = p["itail"], p["i2"]
    gmid_b = 12.0

    # Bias: ibias diode (carries IREF) mirrored to tail and stage-2 sink
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["L_b"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["L_b"], it, vds=0.35)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["L_b"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # Preamp: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], it / 2, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], it / 2, vds=0.85)
    # Gain stage: PMOS CS matched to mirror diode (same Vgs -> no systematic offset)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], i2, vds=0.9)

    wn = p["wn_inv"]
    wp = 2.5 * wn

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.M("MIN", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn, 0.15)
    n.M("MIP", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wp, 0.15)

    # Predictions
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i2)
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m5.gm / (m5.gds + m6.gds)
    cinv = 1.5e-15 * (wn + wp)
    c1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg + m5.cgd * min(a2, 20)
    c2 = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + cinv
    di1 = min(m1.gm * 2 * vod, it)
    dv1 = 0.45 / max(a2, 1)
    t1 = c1 * max(dv1, 0.03) / di1
    t2 = c2 * 0.9 / i2
    ron = 1.0 / (lut.op("n", wn, 0.15, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"] / 0.9 + 1e-12)
    t3 = 0.69 * ron * (cl + 2e-15)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "gain_db": db(a1 * a2)}
```
